// diagnostic E3541

Jet.OutputSettingUndeclared

This output's options set `{key}`, which the package does not declare.

What

This output's options set `{key}`, which the package does not declare.

Why

An output's `options: {settings: ...}` gives its own values to the settings `package.jet` declares, and code reads them as `#build.settings.<key>`.

Fix

Declare `{key}: Type = default` in the `settings: { … }` block of `package.jet`, or drop it from the output's options.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.OutputSettingUndeclared: Tests/UI/OutputSettingUndeclared/stderr.

 Fix: Declare `max_partcles: Type = default` in the `settings: { … }` block of `package.jet`, or drop it from the output's options
